integrity.mathematical_evidence: Complete elementary-collapse proof, explicit missing-triangle orbit filling, signed fixed-face computation, and standalone deterministic checks.

scientific_limitations: A classification for one eleven-vertex tournament, not a uniform family theorem.
The quotient calculation determines only rational homology, not quotient integral torsion or homotopy.
Potential unindexed equivalent results remain a literature risk.
title: The homotopy type and affine homology character of the Paley-\(11\) tournament neighborhood complex
